cues: Gregor Mendel, a monk in Brno, worked on the garden pea from eighteen fifty six to eighteen sixty three, and published in eighteen sixty six.
Nobody understood him until nineteen hundred, when de Vries, Correns and Tschermak rediscovered his work.
He succeeded because of four decisions.
